meta.name: manage-mounts
meta.description: Configure which host directories agent containers can access. View, add, or remove mount allowlist entries. Triggers on "mounts", "mount allowlist", "agent access to directories", "container mounts".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理容器可访问的主机目录挂载
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要控制 agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录
copy.tagline_en: Manage which host directories agent containers can access
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to control which host directories agent containers can access

howto.what: 管理 NanoClaw agent 容器能访问哪些主机目录：查看当前白名单、添加目录（可设为只读或读写）、删除条目或清空。改动写入 mount-allowlist.json，新起的容器自动生效。
howto.when: 当你提到 “mounts”、“mount allowlist”、“container mounts” 等关键词，或要求查看、增删 agent 容器可访问的目录时触发。

say.text: 看一下当前的 mount allowlist 配置
say.note: 列出允许的目录及各自的只读/读写状态

say.text: 把 /data/reports 加到允许访问的目录，只读
say.note: 先校验路径存在，再写入配置

say.text: 从 mount allowlist 里删掉 /data/tmp
say.note: 重写配置，对新起的容器生效

howto.what_en: Manages which host directories NanoClaw agent containers can access: view the allowlist, add directories (read-only or read-write), remove entries, or reset. Changes are written to mount-allowlist.json and apply to new containers.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like "mounts", "mount allowlist", or "container mounts", or when you ask to view or change which directories agent containers can access.

say_en.text: Show me the current mount allowlist
say_en.note: Lists allowed directories and their read-only status

say_en.text: Add /data/reports to the allowlist as read-only
say_en.note: Validates the path, then writes the config
Rewrites config for newly spawned containers
